name: Phototypesetting
summary: Type set by light through a film negative of each letter onto paper or film, instead of from cast metal.
how: Design each weight and width of a family together, so that the machine can mix them.
Set display sizes with tight spacing; film letters can touch.
Draw one master for all sizes; correct the spacing by size.

origin.note: The Lumitype, also called Photon, of René Higonnet and Louis Moyroud sets type from a film disc with light.

adoptions.via: Adrian Frutiger draws Univers as one system of 21 weights and widths, for the Lumitype and for metal.
